purpose: Tracks accessory route records that should not yet be forced into the canonical inventory layer.
rules: Do not create a canonical identity merely because an item appears in a raid reward list.
Numbered variants remain separate until inventory-level evidence establishes equivalence.
Combined accessory names such as Android 21 Wig & Glasses require exact slot/name reconciliation.
Clothing and accessory records must never be merged from set-level terminology alone.
